# appsignal_app (Data Source)

An AppSignal app, looked up by id or by organization_slug, name and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appsignal_app" "web" {
  organization_slug = "example"
  name              = "web"
  environment       = "production"
}

output "notifiers" {
  value = { for n in data.appsignal_app.web.notifiers : n.name => n.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `environment` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `organization_slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `frontend_api_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `notifiers` (List of Object) Notifiers configured for the app. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notifiers))
- `push_api_key` (String, Sensitive)
